authors_reviews.title: Perfect size for hiking!
authors_reviews.text: As I started walking my dogs in the woods a bit more I was slightly paranoid they would get bet up if they slipped or fell or got injured. I has just about everything I could of think of if they got hurt in the woods.Part of me felt like it was lacking but it weights almost nothing and was easy to strap on to the camel back. It has enough useful cleaning wipes to clean up most wounds and the all important tweezers for ticks! I personally added some band aids to the kit so if anything happens to me I can piggy back off it for our short few mile hikes. Its a solid value for the peace of mind I get.
authors_reviews.author: Joseph

authors_reviews.title: good , not great
authors_reviews.text: You keep a emergency kit for my family, why not for the the dog too? Personally I would and did add quick clot and activated charcoal to this kit. I realize it would bring the cost up but my dog is worth it

authors_reviews.author: Zayne Smithyman

authors_reviews.title: Ready to go kit for your pup!
authors_reviews.text: I love the people kits that these guys make and so I thought I’d give this one a try for my furry kids that go on our adventures with us. It did not disappoint. Has everything to take care of them until you can get them to a vet. I haven’t used much of it yet, but the peace of mind that it gives, knowing you are prepared is worth it.
authors_reviews.author: PNT

authors_reviews.title: A must have for pet owners
authors_reviews.text: I got this as a safety percussion. My dog is my whole world and I wanted to be ready for all occasions. I haven’t had the need to use it (thank goodness) but I have the peace of mind that it’s always there for me
authors_reviews.author: Faith Jones

authors_reviews.title: Has everything you need in case of an emergency
authors_reviews.text: I take my dog everywhere on adventures, and one of the things I wanted to buy was a pet medical kit. I feel like this has everything you need and more in case of an emergency. Definitely HIGHLY recommend all pet parents to carry a kit around in case, especially if they go on road trips or mini vacations around the country.
authors_reviews.author: Angela
